The unusual circumstances surrounding the event prompted a joint investigation by the UIU and FIIC,1 and resulted in the subsequent classification as an anomaly. A full timeline and an overview of the investigation has been included in this file.2

SCP-9112 is an adult female Pinacosaurus grangeri.2 It experiences negligible senescence, if at all, and demonstrates extreme regenerative abilities. Testing of these abilities are not considered a necessary function of the Foundation, and as such have been indefinitely halted per General Order 05-LIMITATION-Q2.

Individual plates can be removed but autonomously return to their correct positions once released.

SCP-9116 es el Annapurna I, un macizo en el Himalaya ubicado entre el Rio Marshyangdi y el Valle Pokhara. Toda la vida que alcanza el punto de congelación mientras se encuentra a una altitud de ~7500 metros en SCP-9116 permanecerá perfectamente preservado mediante el éxtasis criogénico prolongado.

When static, these engravings resemble 15th century Arabic calligraphy, although the characters do not correspond to any known extinct or modern language. The teapot is worn, and has several cracks around its rim which prevents a lid from being placed on it.

SCP-9120 is the group designation assigned to four distinct but interconnected anomalous phenomena, and one anomalous entity: SCP-9120-A, SCP-9120-B, SCP-9120-C, SCP-9120-D, and SCP-9120-E.

SCP-9121 fue un evento astronómico que ocurrió encima de la ciudad de Beddington, Maine, el 6 de abril de 2025. El evento en sí fue un eclipse solar antinatural que duró aproximadamente una hora y media. Durante este eclipse, entidades de aquí en adelante denominadas como SCP-9121-1 se volvieron visibles.

How SCP-9122 accessed the channel is currently unknown. SCP-9122 is extrasolar1 in origin, with its exact broadcast location unknown. The transmission itself consists of dialogue in an unintelligible alien language lasting exactly four minutes and thirty-two seconds in length. SCP-9123 refers to a humanoid entity previously described by the Foundation as PoI-99123, a.k.a “Dorian Cillian Sloan”. Its primary anomalous ability is producing verbal commands capable of compelling sapient subjects to perform actions against their own wills. The precise mechanisms of this effect are unknown, except that it exhibits an unusually potent strength against individuals with high CRVs.3 Because of this, it is theorized that the determinant of SCP-9123’s compulsive strength instead r

SCP-9124 is a shared condition wherein blood is able to pass between victims. It is known to afflict seven women, four of which have been identified conclusively. Despite the lack of physical connection between the victims, substances injected into one will appear in the bloodstream of the others some time later, ranging from minutes to weeks, and the heartbeats of each victim can be faintly detected in the others. New victims can be conclusively identified by the presence of the DNA of known vi
SCP-9125 is the root of human unreason.
SCP-9126 is an anomalous subspecies of the ichneumon wasp Podogaster Cactorum. SCP-9126 instances appear identical to their non-anomalous counterparts, and behave mostly identically as well.

SCP-9127 is a 75 cm long bansuri2 made out of a single long shaft of bamboo, featuring six holes for playing. The embouchure is made of ivory and has been tied with a thin thread to prevent cracking. SCP-9127 is adorned with jewels, which display no anomalous effects. Reports have shown that the flute demonstrates immense thaumaturgical abilities, only activating in the presence of a flutist who is learned in Indian classical music and ragas.3 The thaumaturgical abilities aforementioned include

SCP-9128 is a book titled the book of all things by dado. Despite its size, SCP-9128 has an infinite number of pages. SCP-9128 is a dictionary containing all possible combinations of letters and their definitions.

SCP-9129 is an abnormally large humanoid skeleton discovered in the Sakai Scrub Natural Area. It is interred upright, with its upper half exposed. Before containment, the remains were overgrown with crossvine. The ribcage has been distended by a massive, empty wasp's nest. Layered white stains under the orbital and nasal cavities are attributed to bird feces. The bones remain connected in the absence of ligaments. The flesh has entirely decayed.

SCP-9130-1 instances measurably have a lower Hume reading than baseline, indicating that they are acting as a constant reality sink. No title or similarly recognizable clues to signify an author or origin are present with its cover otherwise depicting an encircled hexagram through iron rivets. SCP-9138 is the newly dominant moral framework of the universe as of 25/06/1950. Souls so recognised by their community are sorted into a variety of paradisiacal afterlives which reflect their actions while living. These afterlives embody SCP-9138-A’s ethical and aesthetic values, and are structured to reward and further perpetuate such behaviour.

Any deviations in diet have resulted in severe nausea, vomiting, and involuntary muscle spasms.

This process is known as SCP-9151-C and it lasts anywhere from a second to an hour. Afterwards, the two SCP-9151-B instances become indistinguishable from a non-anomalous orange.

Manifestations are typically fairly brief, with the longest recorded manifestation lasting for 7 minutes. SCP-9165 is a tall, humanoid entity approximately 1.9 meters tall, referred to as "Indrid Cold." The entity is dressed formally, wearing a suit or coat and pants made of the same unknown material. The entity is known to teleport and appear in multiple locations at once. SCP-9165 is described by exposed personnel to be visually intimidating even when viewed from a distance. SCP-9165 is known to communicate through telepathy.

Prior to Foundation discovery, it had been sighted seven kilometers southwest of ████████, but its current whereabouts are unknown.

SCP-9202 is a worldwide network, thaumaturgic in nature, that allows for parsing and transmission of emotion and subconscious intent at a higher rate than would be normally possible. SCP-9202 is responsible for the level of advanced reasoning and coordination required for modern civilization. SCP-9202 originates from thaumochemical reactions inside of the human brain.
Discovered in Whistlebay, Wyoming in 1992 following a number of sightings and reports of kidnappings by the entity. Moved to Site-19 following negotiations.

SCP-9204 is a male Golden Retriever dog colloquially referred to as Milo. When given a verbal command to "fetch," SCP-9204 will always retrieve an object. This retrieval is uninhibited by distance, size, and other factors that would normally limit feasibility. A minority of requests result in retrieval of an object other than the one requested. The significance of non-target objects retrieved is unknown.

Despite this, the industrial grounds of SCP-9318 still operate from a secluded location within a local coniferous forest. Written atop the entrance gate are the words “ANIMAL HOSPITAL” on a yellow plastic plaque. Deliveries of d

SCP-9319 is a loosely-connected series of concepts in the noosphere pertaining to an individual that does not exist. When collected and considered in full, the constructed narrative indicates that they pertain to Arjan Devi, age 26, a resident of Albany, New York. This individual does not exist on any government records, and is currently survived by oral histories, memories, and unofficial, physical keepsakes. Instances of SCP-9319 are anomalously persistent, and have survived multiple attempts

SCP-9320 is the language used by presumably all species of tree. Initially thought to be anomalous due to a prior lack of evidence supporting the idea of plant intelligence, Foundation research has concluded that the language is, in fact, entirely ordinary, as all of the biological processes used to construct the language are already known to mundane science.
SCP-9321 is an abandoned Khrushchevka apartment, located in Корлики (Korliki), that displays anomalous properties akin to the physiology and behaviour of plants.

SCP-9323 is a 5.1 meters long clown car, with style that is indicative of a vintage car, of which is capable of fitting up to 58 adult persons and 77 individual adolescents without coming to a complete stop, though is certainly able to fit more than this limit when immobile. Regardless of how feeble SCP-9323 may appear, it has strength on par with a modern off-road terrain automobile and is capable of breaking through walls of its own volition. SCP-9324 is a nonfunctional telephone booth discovered in Grand River National Grassland, South Dakota, on February 7, 2013. Details behind its construction are ambiguous. Physical deterioration implies an origin placed far earlier than 2013, although hiker reports neither deny nor confirm this.

SCP-9325 is a Boeing 777-300ER, intended to fly as Fly-Saf Airlines Flight 8400, which has been trapped since 12/12/2024 in a spatial anomaly of unknown cause. As a result, once daily at 0800 hours local time, SCP-9325 spontaneously manifests and de-manifests above random portions of American airspace. It is currently unknown how SCP-9325 remains actively airborne; only one untrained passenger is aboard, designated SCP-9325-1.

SCP-9326 is an anomalous subatomic particle capable of severing the covalent bonds within organic molecules. This occurs once SCP-9326 passes within 1 angstrom1 of the bond between a targeted pair of atoms. SCP-9326 appears to cause a phase-shift between bonded atoms, causing all bonding orbitals to move destructively out-of-phase into their respective anti-bonding forms.
Every instance of SCP-9326 breaking a molecular bond is paired with an instantaneous increase in its kinetic energy. SCP-9326

SCP-9327 is a DVD disk that is deep blue in coloration and 12 centimeters in diameter. Its corresponding plastic case1 is also deep blue in coloration and labeled "Snack Bar Simulator" on its front side in the Microsoft Comic Sans font. No producer, manufacturer, or distributor are listed anywhere on SCP-9327's case, and its origin remains unknown. All forests designated under SCP-9328 contain SCP-9328-A. SCP-9328-A is a virulent pattern. It is inadvisable to enter forests or interact with this pattern. When exposed to strong light, instances bury their roots and adopt an immobile state in which their ability to generate SCP-9329-2 is significantly reduced.

SCP-9330 es el cadáver de Vladimír Smutný, antiguo amnestesista en activo empleado en el Sitio-███. SCP-9330 presenta un avanzado grado de descomposición típico de una exposición prolongada al agua. Aunque la naturaleza de SCP-9330 dificulta una observación precisa, no se ha observado ningún avance apreciable en su estado de descomposición desde el ██-██-2023. Las muestras de SCP-9330 han demostrado ser resistentes a los agentes putrefactos y disolventes convencionales.
SCP-9330 expulsa continua

SCP-9331 is currently downloadable on online independent videogame hosting platform itch.io for free, although it was priced at 2 USD up until October 2014; attempts to remove SCP-9331 from the store have resulted in devices overheating and crashing, invariably. The non-anomalous tradition, practiced in Britain and once in the United States of America, involves a wedded couple convincing a ceremonial jury that they have not regretted their marriage for a year; successful claimants swear a specific “flitch oath” and are awarded a flitch of bacon (hence the name “flitch trials”). Knowles wrote in his report that the masks had been found near the village of Poporo with their rims caked in what appeared to have been dried blood.

SCP-9336 consists of two creatures resembling men. Moved to Site Black from Fort Leavenworth 1989. Origin is unknown, but both were discovered during an FBI raid on a meeting of the Valdez and Konstantinidis supermarket syndicates at a Dyker Heights restaurant in Brooklyn. They were found huddled in a storage room.

Operation LEANDER confirmed that competitors are translocated during this time to SCP-9337-A (See Addendum-1). Upon remanifestation, all competitors but one are found to be in advanced stages of rhabdomyolysis.3 Subjects afflicted expire by renal failure 1 to 2 days post-exposure.

SCP-9340 are a collection of 71 3-dimensional cross-sections of 4-dimensional simplices, formed of an unknown nonbaryonic material. On examination, they appear to be tablets of slate-coloured stone, which perpetually emit smoke. Their surfaces are etched with a variety of pictograms, which anomalously convey a unique message when read. Comprehension of these messages induces one of the strongest agnostic effects known to the Foundation. Personnel bear the responsibility of understanding.

SCP-9341 is Site-CB,1 a facility subordinate to Site-19. Site-CB was originally a research facility, but had to take up containment duties past its expected limits as a response to the Fracturing Raids. After an incident further elaborated in this file's sub-documentation, it turned into SCP-9341.

Item 9342 is an ironstone slab obstructing a 90cm by 200cm doorway in the central chamber of Item 9342/A, a semi-artificial subterranean network south-west of Stuttgart, Germany.
SCP-9343 is the collective classification for a number of associated objects and anomalous phenomenon discovered in the north of England and throughout Scotland.

SCP-9344 is a contagious phenomenon affecting islands between latitudes 21°N and 21°S. Islands affected by SCP-9344 evolve towards a specific template, with changes occurring to their geography, settlement, businesses, and population according to a regular pattern. This process takes between 15-30 months, tending to occur more quickly on islands with larger numbers of visitors. SCP-9345 is a severed human head and neck belonging to a woman identified as Susana Méndez Aguilar. Despite its current state, it exhibits no signs of putrefaction or decay. All samples collected from SCP-9345 regenerate almost immediately after tissue is removed; the limits of this regeneration have not been tested due to the value of the anomaly and concerns about inflicting irreparable damage.
SCP-9345’s main anomalous effect is triggered when a drop of human blood is introduced in its mouth.

SCP-9346 is an estuarine black mangove1 island located near Site-101's aquaflora containment wing. SCP-9346 hosts a variety of terrestrial and marine flora and fauna expected of a microhabitat of its kind (see containment document 9346.02 for a detailed report on SCP-9346's biota).


SCP-9346-A instance.

SCP-9348 is a large humanoid entity located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, the location of which is designated Location-9348. SCP-9348 is primarily mechanical in nature, utilizing complex mechanical structures to move its body.

SCP-9349 was a domestic horse (Equus ferus caballus) which seemingly possessed human-level intelligence and was anomalously capable of speech. The entity claimed to have once been a human transformed into its current form by thaumaturgy. As SCP-9349 was never fully within Foundation custody, further information is limited largely to the entity’s own unverified claims.

SCP-9350 refers to a phenomenon affecting Warwick Castle, in Warwick, England. Exclusively during night hours, approximately once per 10-21 days, an SCP-9350 event will occur within the castle and its grounds (hereby dubbed a “revelry event”).

SCP-9353 is a phenomenon in which a tree (regardless of species) gains sentience akin to that of a wild animal's. Affected subjects are able to spread SCP-9353 to other trees through direct contact, typically through the roots. The origin of SCP-9353 is unknown.

Sun damage has not impacted the detailing of the work, a portion of which is significantly more precise than should be possible with a conventional brush.2

The station emits a broadcast that can only be received by motorists driving on Interstate 77 between the cities of Charleston and Beckley. Subject's immediate family, consisting of his parents, a wife, and two sons, reside in his hometown of Noakhali District, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

It follows the average building plan of an Urgent Care building, standing at one story, with 1300.6426 square meters of space. Entering the building does not trigger the object's anomalous properties. If spoken to, any staff will resemble normal humans in appearance and speech patterns.

Occasionally, carrying out SCP-9370 may create auditory and visual hallucinations of a humanoid entity. These persist during the duration of SCP-9370 despite the use of protective measures, yet do not result in lasting harm.

SCP-9375 refers to a set of thaumaturgy-based mechanical entities that inhabited Earth during the Ediacaran period, approximately 555 million years ago. While it is currently believed that there was a small population of SCP-9375, a disproportionately large amount of fossils have survived on account of various thaumaturgic enhancements to their durability.

Though exact details of how they accomplish this are currently unknown, SCP-9376 do not appear to be capable of affecting substances, items, or entities any heavier than the instance’s weight.

The principal anomaly is a three-day temporal desynchronization event, triggered by an unknown interaction between the nuclear reactor powering the ship and an extratemporal phenomenon. The time experienced is relative to the interior of the ship, moving three times slower compared to exterior time.

SCP-9380 refers to the lesser deity of violence, chaos, and firearms that you will meet - known as 'Lord Vanaman.' SCP-9380 ontologically opposes ordered structures, seeking to break all order. You will be sacrificed to sate this urge.

SCP-9383 is a neon Budweiser Beer Light. When lit up, an unknown yeast species, designated SCP-9383-1, will begin to grow on any plastics that absorb the light. SCP-9383's light is able to penetrate organic material as well, causing SCP-9383-1 to begin to grow from the microplastics found within the bodies of humans as well as other organisms.

SCP-9384 is a humanoid entity possessing teleportation abilities, with the given name "Johnny Mendoza". Currently, SCP-9384 uses its ability to work as a freelance commercial truck and bus driver under the branding "Johnny-On-The-Spot".

SCP-9388 contains a variety of animals typically found in non-anomalous petting zoos, designated SCP-9388-1 instances. All SCP-9388-1 instances display an anomalous form of Leucism which, alongside the loss of pigmentation, causes multicolored flecks throughout their coats.

SCP-9391 is a domestic cat (Felis catus) with tabby fur, suffering from mild PTSD. It is classified as a high threat reality bender, although does not seem to possess total conscious control over its abilities, usually restricting itself subconsciously to the following:

Total control of the motion of one (1) object within sight, akin to general conventions of "telekinesis". Requires concentration.
Alteration of size, ranging between 0.4 mm and 144 m. Requires a constant, conscious effort.

SCP-9393 is a doorway in a cornfield in Hooker County, Nebraska. The frame is made from black cherry wood. From the north, the doorway appears to be filled with dark gray mist. From the south, the doorway appears completely black.

SCP-9396 is an intangible force; however, it is able to manifest a physical avatar in order to interact with individuals directly. This avatar takes the form of a large2 baseball, sporting a cape to denote its back, as well as a pair of human eyes and set of human teeth to denote its front. SCP-9396 answers to the name, "Mr. Baseball."

It appeared at a depth of 475 metres below sea level in Beaufort's Dyke, an ocean trench approximately 21km off the Western coast of Scotland and 19km from the Eastern coast of Northern Ireland on the 14th of August 1969. It is capable of travel from such surfaces to any other pair of reflective surfaces within line of sight. Sufficiently large single reflective surfaces (greater than 1m2) are also capable of hosting SCP-9414. In the event that its host surfaces are destroyed, SCP-9414 will manifest on a new pair of surfaces nearby, even if those surfaces are not within line of sight.

Externally, SCP-9420 resembles a small, hairless domestic pig, but with markedly viscoelastic soft tissue that behaves under manipulation like partially leavened bread dough. No eyes, ears or other sensory organs are visible. SCP-9420 has no identifiable limbs or skeletal structure; the body appears to be composed primarily of uniform, elastic tissue.

It is noteworthy for hosting the world’s leading anthropoktonic cottage industry, buttressed both by local workshops and a Foundation-sponsored complex at its edge2. SCP-9430 is a collection of anomalous items being deposited in Le Freeport, Singapore, and the Luxembourg High Security Hub, Luxembourg City. These items have so far been divided into two categories, designated SCP-9430-1 and SCP-9430-2.

Oh Lord, this location was once a place of honor, the abandoned Foundation Site-45185, in those chilly woods of Krakow, Poland. We have left it alone in our mortal limitations for the last twenty years, but the shafts of Your light have graced it in our absence still. These sacred walls were a place of care, of medicine, of healing, for those which we had kept safe and hidden from the world at large.

SCP-9434 appears to be a standard dog whistle. When blown, all nearby dogs will respond in a variety of ways. On first hearing the whistle blow, subjects typically respond with shock. On subsequent exposures, subjects begin to react with aggression, barking at and sometimes attacking the user. Finally, if SCP-9434 continues to be used past this point, subjects display a clear decrease in mood.

It is inferred that all linear objects, as well as concepts cognitively associated with lines, are perceived by it as "threads." It is currently theorized that the strings posited by string theory also fall within the scope of its perception of "threads."

Instances of SCP-9442-B are genetically identical to humans, and currently possess no known form of sustenance. SCP-9446 is a Foundation-developed device created under Project WATCHMEN, an initiative dedicated to the study of temporal mechanics and the nature of causality.

This is in the form of the sporadic manifestation of a non-existent state holiday that occurs on the Monday after American Thanksgiving. Upon occurrence, this holiday will mark the start of a single-day deer hunting season within the state of Pennsylvania that lacks typical restrictions.1

SCP-9460 is a Petraria Arcatinus catapult that identifies itself as "Terry Ian The Seventh." SCP-9460 is capable of speech, perceiving its surroundings, and moving independently. SCP-9460 is fluent in English & French, also claiming to speak Spanish2. SCP-9460 has displayed intelligence and reasoning skills equivalent to those of a young adult male, speaking in a tone similar to that of the nearest individual.
SCP-9460 possesses a distinct interest in competitive wrestling.

SCP-9461 is a wooden door knob, similar to ones found in residential homes in much of Europe and North America. Its anomalous properties manifest when affixed to a door, wherein the property the door resides in (henceforth referred to as SCP-9461-2) will, within 10 minutes of SCP-9461 being affixed, be subject to summary demolition through various means. However, the door, door hinge, flooring, supports, and anything else that keeps the door SCP-9461 is affixed to standing will remain undamaged.

SCP-9465 is a spacecraft designated the ITV1 Ouroboros, capable of exit and re-entry between timelines.

The contents of each SCP-9466 instance detail the Norwegian perspective of the Battle of Stamford Bridge at varying time stages, including events that occurred before and after the conflict, following the same linear timeline. Additionally, SCP-9522 becomes aware of the belief, intention, and information that the user is consciously trying to conceal. SCP-9522 has never successfully been lied to.
This does not mean SCP-9522 is omniscient.

SCP-9693 was a concert performed in the Washington DC Capital Centre on 11/11/74 by the musician David Bowie as part of the third leg of the "Diamond Dogs Tour." All those attending SCP-9693, including backstage workers, on-stage performers, and audience members, spontaneously vanished multiple times during the performances of the songs "Moonage Daydream," "Memory of a Free Festival", and "It's Gonna Be Me," reappearing when the songs presumably ended. During these periods, those outside the con

SCP-9694 refers to a 755 acre waste management site located in Aurora, Colorado. The site first came to the Foundation's attention when an anonymous user uploaded a video to the 4chan board /x/, claiming that the site was "haunted" and that a network of tunnels existed below the surface.
These claims were investigated and verified by local law enforcement following the disappearance of Robert ████, a well-known cave-diving content creator. Using radio-echo mapping technology, a dense tunnel netw

SCP-9695 refers to an event which takes place every year on April 15th in Candlestick Park in San Francisco, California. At 7:00 PM local time, the baseball game between the Los Angeles Dodgers vs. the San Francisco Giants which took place on April 15th, 1991, will remanifest on the field.
The field of Candlestick Park is the only area affected by SCP-9695. All entities manifested by SCP-9695 are physically indistinguishable from their non-anomalous counterparts. The players and equipment manife
SCP-9696 is the merging of the SCP Foundation with the concepts of normalcy and the status quo within the noosphere.1

SCP-9697 constitutes the former official 5k cross country course at ███ ████ High School in Arizona. Historic newspaper excerpts and personal testimony from former runners alike characterize the hilly stretch as especially grueling for the sport.

SCP-9698 is 22-year-old Martin Gulch. At will, SCP-9698 is capable of physically transforming itself to take on the appearance, skills and mannerisms of renowned athlete Michael Jordan. Despite this transformation appearing biomechanical in nature, SCP-9698 does not appear to contain any mechanical components.
Despite taking on the form, skills and mannerisms of Jordan, SCP-9698 maintains the same personality and intentions.

SCP-9699 is a Foundation-made anomaly designed by the joint efforts of multiple high-level thaumaturges and imprisoned Sarkics, overseen by O5-7 and the Ethics Committee Director. Following the successful birthing of SCP-9699, all persons associated with its creation were amnesticised and released into civilian life with updated medical documentation denoting their releases a result of dissociative amnesia.
SCP-9699 itself is an anomalous humanoid of indistinguishable sex possessing the anatomy

SCP-9700 is a collective designation for cartographic artifacts, designated SCP-9700-A, and the anomalous locations they depict. Each SCP-9700-A instance is an inert paper map that accurately represents an anomalous site later discovered through use of associated SCP-9700-A instances. It is unknown who previously owned the instances of SCP-9700-A, or where they originated.

SCP-9701 is an anomalous member of the Leporidae familiy1 that is capable of Level 3 reality bending. The only confirmed physical details are that the entity has white fur and red eyes. SCP-9701 migrates between the Earth and the Moon regularly. This behavior is unexplained.
Researchers have identified 118 likely SCP-9701 sightings since 2000, with 71 of those being confirmed. Of the 71 confirmed SCP-9701 sightings, 34 of them occurred in proximity to a natural disaster, 47 were in rural areas,
SCP-9702 designates a collection of events that facilitate the uncontrolled transport of water into buildings. SCP-9702 will usually only affect one specific room or region of a building.

SCP-9703 is an anomalous weather broadcast that appears suddenly during off-peak news cycles. The content of the broadcast before, during, and after an incident varies, but each outbreak follows a similar pattern of events, outlined below:

SCP-9705 has the appearance of a bronze Greek statue with its head replaced by a flame. The flame consists of a continual flickering between different faces of a subset of its previous targets. While the flame can bristle, SCP-9705 has exclusively used minimal nonverbal communication to set up games of sport. SCP-9705 has seemingly endless stamina and incalculable strength, which it has only displayed in Incident-9705-A. While not hunting, SCP-9705 shows abilities consistent with top athletes ir

SCP-9706 refers to two defunct railroad crossing signs (SCP-9706-1 and SCP-9706-2) located in rural Niedersachsen, Germany. The signs are sentient and are capable of telepathic communication. While psychically-sensitive individuals are able to receive this exchange, the anomalies are unable to perceive any communication outside of their own. The gates of both signals are locked in a closed position and are pointing in the same direction, presumably through automation error. They were first disco

SCP-9707 is the collective designation for 9 Mattel Hot Wheels toy cars, individually designated SCP-9707-1 through SCP-9707-9. Each instance is structurally indistinguishable from its non-anomalous commercial counterpart. They exhibit autonomous, self-propelled locomotion and self-directed driving. Measurable performance variability1 has been observed both between instances and within the same instance across separate trials. Recorded metrics fluctuate in a manner not attributable to environmen

SCP-9708 was a severe, tornadic supercell thunderstorm which occurred on May 11, 2027. SCP-9708 began south of Guymon, Oklahoma, an area highly accustomed to tornadoes. SCP-9708 came to Foundation attention due to its unusual duration, moving over 200 kilometers in three hours, moving abnormally to areas of suitable atmospheric saturation for the continuation of the storm. Lightning dramatically increased at times when SCP-9708's course took it near to areas incapable of supporting it. Embedded

SCP-9709 is a Mk.2 hand grenade manufactured sometime during WW2. It possesses a distinct camouflage patterning across its outer shell.1 SCP-9709's outer shell also shows various signs of disrepair, including dents, nicks and an oil stain pattern consistent with long periods of field use. SCP-9709 appears to be fully sapient and highly communicative, speaking in a raspy voice. X-ray tests confirm that it vocalizes by repeatedly pressing its striker spring against its percussion cap in patterns t

SCP-9710-A is an experimental .aic (Artificially Intelligent Conscript) program created by the late Researcher Adeline Chan using the codebase of Fiore.aic. Researcher Chan undertook this creation as a personal project without Foundation knowledge, but beyond her failure to notify her higher-ups, it was fully within the purview of her role as the AIAD (Artificial Intelligence Applications Division) Deputy Head of Innovation. The intended purpose of SCP-9710-A is still uncertain, as it was not do

SCP-9711 refers to a species of humanoid crustaceans inhabiting a network of undersea caverns and tunnels beneath major oceanic plates. Instances of SCP-9711 have an average height of approximately 6′3 ft, with a chitinous exoskeleton that appears red in adults and silver in juveniles, two bioluminescent xanthous eyes, and four limbs: two lower limbs for locomotion and two claw-like appendages. SCP-9711 demonstrates cognitive abilities comparable to humanity, including abstract reasoning, langua

SCP-9712 is a curved two-pronged sword. Its primary anomalous property is to split any solid it touches in half, at an atomic level, causing nuclear fission. Furthermore, SCP-9712 manifests in baseline reality only during select times of day, which coincide with the five prayer times observed by Muslims1.
When SCP-9712's blade makes contact with a solid object, all atoms within 5 nanometers of its edge undergo nuclear fission. The chain reaction and other effects typical of fission are restricte

SCP-9714 is a lighthouse. Its construction consists of a circular concrete tower standing at 31.2m, topped by a light room with Fresnel lens and painted in horizontal black and white bands. Attached to SCP-9714's base is a nine-story building presumedly designed to house lighthouse operators or other appropriate personnel.
SCP-9714 is capable of autonomous relocation, vanishing from one position and subsequentially reappearing in another at seemingly random intervals. Materializations can occur
[OMITTED]
SCP-9716 is a K6-model red telephone box. It operates like a conventional telephone box, except that it requires no electricity or connection to phone lines.

SCP-9717 is a humanoid entity capable of instantaneously transferring any number of body parts from a living primate of its choosing onto itself. Transferred body parts instantly replace what was previously present.

SCP-9719 is a valley with an area of approximately 160 km2 located in Kermanshah Province, Iran. As of December 2025, it has a population of 11,942, who reside in three main villages and numerous smaller settlements. 62.5% of the population speak Southern Kurdish (Xwarin) as their first language, with the remainder speaking a dialect of Persian. The vast majority of the population are bilingual. Locals report that Assyrian and Jewish communities were present during the 20th century, but had full
DS-HEAVEN is a non-Euclidean office space accessed through a manifesting interior door and presenting as a single desk, lamp, and stamp bearing the phrase NOTHING EVER HAPPENS.
SCP-9722 is an eleven-second digital video recorded on 18 June 2018 at a private birthday gathering on the outskirts of Madison, Wisconsin.

Discovered in late 2004, initially identified through 4chan message board (9/30/2004) before secondary identifiers located through other online avenues (Omegle, 10/28/2004) (Something Awful, 11/03/2004) (MySpace, 11/03/2004) (rotten.com 11/04/2004) (slendermansion.com 11/09/2004). SCP-9723 is a paranormality targeting isolated individuals lacking stable connective social circles, sometimes existing in more extreme areas of the internet. Initial interaction appears as a series of conversations wi

SCP-9724 refers to a small abandoned house situated at the outskirts of Hammond, Indiana. The dwelling shows signs of deterioration, with severe structural damage present throughout the building. A rusted plaque near the house's entrance is thought to have at one point displayed an inscription, although the original text is illegible. The building contains three rooms, including a storage unit and the room that housed SCP-9724-1 at the time of discovery. The structure contains no windows or natu
SCP-9725 are the steps necessary for the creation of homunculi. A digital replication is available for viewing in Attached Document 9725-A.

Object discovered in late 2002, anomalous properties fully understood by summer of 2003. LOUSE WARREN established as forward base/depot above Wind Cave. Object has so far enabled the termination of 32 targets; 23 by starvation, 5 by dehydration, 3 by suicide, and 1 unclear. When the target expires in a bathroom, which has occurred so far in 21 cases, all fluid containers will be found filled to the brim with tar pitch.

SCP-9730 refers to a small humanoid entity currently suspended within a large concrete block, which has been fitted into a load-bearing wall in Site-001's foundations. SCP-9730 is perpetually unaging, and analysis using advanced imaging technology has revealed that it has remained in a newborn-like state since its containment in 1876.

SCP-9731 designates a gestalt consciousness, formed on 13-05-2025 from the lower-level employees of North Star Interactive. This combination was facilitated by a Neo-Sarkic flesh crafter hired by the company's upper management with the objective of “increasing output quality and work speed.” Due to the flesh crafter's presumed absorption into SCP-9731, the process by which the combination was achieved is unknown and at this time irreversible.

Located on the Patefield continental shelf above an extinct subduction zone—trench extends down 1,500ft of visible oceanic environment. Depth of non-viewable environment unknown due to waveform and signal disturbances. OUTPOST-9 lies within the aphotic zone.2

SCP-9737 may exist. This statement is always true, but simultaneously impossible to verify. SCP-9737 has, for brief and undetermined periods of time, existed. The same can be said of its nonexistence. This is the core concept of SCP-9737; it is the most unlikely item to ever exist.
SCP-9737 has a physical appearance2. It is alive, and capable of self-actuated motion. It can speak English. It is, by some reports3, human. SCP-9737 was reportedly born in London. It has one, definite, consistent loc

SCP-9740 is a .ZIP file titled 'Bookmarked For The Penman.' that appeared on Site-0's central computing system on 31/3/2023. SCP-9740 can be uncompressed and accessed regularly despite the incalculable number of folders present within it. Said folders each contain a variable number of pages detailing the lives of all sapient individuals who are, have been, and will be officially employed by the Special Containment Procedures Foundation.
These pages are highly expositive, presenting all conceivab
Item SCP-9742 is a exoparasitic organism with a three phase life cycle. This cycle repeats over the course of 9-10 days.

SCP-9743 refers to the ongoing CK-class Reality Restructuring event in which SCP-343 is attempting to convert the planet earth into a perceived ideal state.
Without notice and without triggering Foundation warning systems, SCP-343 enacted global restructuring to realign society from its ongoing state as of 2026-5-10 to its state as of 1999-12-31, ten seconds prior to midnight. Despite the change in circumstances to match 1999, no retrocausality or direct temporal travel was observed.1

SCP-9745 was a lineage of Swedish Friesian1 cows that were capable of altering the political beliefs of individuals upon the consumption of their milk, designated SCP-9745-A. Individuals affected by the anomaly consistently showed moderate reformist left wing political beliefs, consistent with the beliefs of the Swedish Social Democratic Party2 during the time that the anomaly was active. A major aspect of this set of political beliefs is that change should be brought about by political reform,

SCP-9750 resembles a damaged sheet of parchment, approximately 30cm long and 16cm wide. Analysis of the stains present suggest that SCP-9750 was artificially stained, thought the chemicals used could not be identified.
SCP-9753 is an industry-standard white ceramic mug. SCP-9753 remains within 1% deviation of a sample of 24 similar mugs.

SCP-9755 is a 246 cm tall bronze statue, originally installed in the Members' Lobby of the House of Commons, Palace of Westminster, commemorating former UK Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher. It originally depicted its subject mid-address: Right arm extended, index finger raised, left hand holding rolled papers.1 SCP-9755 has been impervious to all forms of damage tested on it so far. SCP-9755 was originally created as a non-anomalous statue to be displayed in the Members' Lobby of the Palace of W
SCP-9757 is the relationship between two objects, SCP-9757-1 and SCP-9757-2.

SCP-9760 is a human male, apparently in its late 20's. SCP-9760 is capable of instantly disappearing from its current location and reappearing in the parking lot of any filling station,1 though it has a strong preference for those with attached convenience stores. If SCP-9760 is taken anywhere other than a filling station, the station's parking lot, or the station's convenience store, it will immediately teleport to the nearest such establishment.
When left to its own devices, SCP-9760 will loit

SCP-9761 is the phenomenon of perceptual disjunction. It is commonly conjectured that conscious experience is directly a product of physical states of the body; so that consciousness is simply a necessary product of the existence of the human brain. This is incorrect: consciousness is phenomenologically parasitic, latching itself onto sufficiently complex physical structures. Conscious experience then produces impulses within the brain in a feedback loop, creating the experience of “choice”.

This effect is consistent across all species. Evaporation will begin at an individual's head, and conclude with their right pinky toe. Individuals undergoing the process have reported it to be painless, yet uncomfortable. As the brain dissolves, subjects quickly become incomprehensible a

If the statement is a true fact regarding SCP-9765, the green light will activate 🟢. If the statement is false regarding SCP-9765, the red light will activate 🟢. Statements not relevant to the properties or history of SCP-9765 do not cause a light to activate 🟢.
SCP-9765 was recovered from a self-storage facility in Tre

SCP-9766 is possibly in orbit around the Earth, and may or may not be visible rapidly moving across the sky. Its flightpath is presumably sequestered to areas of low Christian population, producing an intense bodily light for all onlookers below. The figure has been mistaken by the public on occasion for:

Tenía siete años cuando mi padre me dijo que, de mayor, me convertiría en uno de los hombres más ricos del mundo. Me sentó en el reluciente balcón blanco de su ático de lujo favorito de Londres, con toda la población de la Tierra bajo nuestros pies como hormigas, y me dijo que, cuando alcanzara la mayoría de edad, heredaría un puesto en la empresa en la que trabajaba, el lugar al que dedicaba la mayor parte de su vida.
Por aquel entonces, yo la veía como una empresa realmente enorme que dominaba

SCP-9771 is a Casio Privia PX-55 88 key keyboard piano. SCP-9771 has the ability to be played without an external nor internal power source, the mechanism by which it does this is unknown. Object also is capable of producing sound without a connected sound system. If one is plugged in, sound will emit through the sound system instead as normal. SCP-9771 otherwise displays no other anomalous effects and plays within normal parameters.

Object recovered in 1984 from the estate of Earl Bruce (Brentwood, Los Angeles). Bruce was a popular American actor famed for his performance in Western films and for playing the lead role in "BLOODSPORT", a detective procedural airing on NBC between 1972 and 1979. Bruce was active in local politics, standing as a candidate in the 1977 mayoral elections. Additionally, he was a collector of antiquities — believed this is how he came into possession of SCP-9773.

If thoughts are animals, SCP-9774 is a tiger, concealed in dappled shade, skittish, an ambush predator. Clarity is a thrown stone. Hunger is a shared reference.

SCP-9775 is the fungus Sclerocystis perobscura1 (formerly Glomus perobscurum2), a species unknown to the superveil scientific community. SCP-9775 is an obligate-symbiont arbuscular mycorrhizal fungus with close phylogenetic relation to other such fungi,3 with its plant symbionts collectively designated SCP-9775-A. SCP-9776 resembles the first sitting US president, George Washington. SCP-9776 is sickly and displays symptoms akin to Moeller's disease. SCP-9776 has also lost significant amounts of brain function, largely due to a significant loss of brain matter during its initial creation period. This, combined with its severely damaged larynx, is likely why it is unable to speak.

Analysis of recorded incidents indicate that during the occurrence of this phenomenon, the character with whom the subject individual (hereafter referred to as "subject") holds the strongest positive feelings at the time of the event (defined as SCP-9777-A) is active in the subject's vicinity. SCP-9778 is a spatial anomaly located inside the "Super Sushi World" building in Suwa, Nagano. The restaurant's sushi conveyor belt, which would normally run between the dining area and the kitchen, instead connects to a vast, labyrinthine space that extends the track by several hundred kilometers with no measured upper extent. SCP-9779 was an anomalous broadcast received by the Foundation on 21/10/2026. This broadcast could be received even if the laws of physics are radically different between the sending location and the receiving one. These properties also prevented it from being detected by non-anomalous equipment, thus preventing civilian access to the broadcast. A translation of the first part of the message is provided below.

SCP-9780 is an entity currently located within an apartment in Denver, Colorado. Descriptions of its appearance vary among observers, however the appearance of SCP-9780 to a given observer is consistent across multiple observations. Some features are consistent across observers:

It is living.
It is aware of the presence of an observer.
It will attempt to move away from an observer.
It appears odd for a reason the observer cannot readily identify.

He was discovered by the Foundation in the small town of [REDACTED], after the local police station started receiving reports of a "fire controlling wizard". SCP-9782 is a humanoid entity. Its appearance, identity, and origin are all unknown. No photograph of it has ever been obtained, and no two witnesses have described it the same way.

SCP-9785 is a 15 cm handheld containment chamber used to capture and store minor anomalous phenomena. The device operates in two configurations: a dormant standby state and an active operational mode triggered by verbal or physical command.

SCP-9787 is the collective term referring to 201,378 anomalous instances of Polistes aurifer1 nested inside of a gray 2014 Honda Civic Si. An instance of SCP-9787 possesses unusual intelligence and durability, extreme pettiness, and the ability to telekinetically exert 0.03N of force on an object within sight. SCP-9788 appears to possess a greatly increased mental capacity compared to that of the average human, being capable of playing Chess at a high level. At random intervals, SCP-9788 will ask the nearest individual

SCP-9789 is a non-transmissible neurodegenerative disease comprising two phases, SCP-9789-A and SCP-9789-B, which together form an AB Cycle. Disease progression is associated with, and therefore tracked by, the number of AB Cycles.

SCP-9790 refers to an underground structure located on the outskirts of Minsk, Belarus. The structure first came into the attention of the SCP Foundation following a review of all catalogued Foundation properties on 24/03/2020. SCP-9790 was designated as "Site-0", with a date of acquisition listed as 30/10/1961, the records of its original owner having been redacted.
SCP-9790 can only be entered through a 5 meter long metal tunnel, descending from a hatch similar in appearance to that of a bomb
SCP-9792 is a humanoid silhouette visible when reaching relativistic speed.

SCP-9795 consists of specimens from various animal species infected with a currently unknown disease. Infection results in the progressive loss of several functions and behavioral traits typically associated with the affected species. Breathing-like movements continue to occur, although no biological function has been identified.
The appearance of SCP-9795 varies depending on the infected animal. Most animals retain their original form, although some become unrecognizable and may be mistaken for

SCP-9797 is an anomalous, contagious disease affecting exclusively human subjects (referred to as SCP-9797-A) initially resembling common depressive mood disorders. Its vector of transmission is a thick black fluid generated (referred to as SCP-9797-B) by SCP-9797-A instances. SCP-9797-A subjects invariably share additive symptoms in five phases of infection (noted as SCP-9797-A-1 through -5):
Phase 1: Symptoms are mostly indistinguishable from major depressive disorder or similar mood disorders

SCP-9799 is a spectral entity resembling Ronald Bradbury, a Foundation agent who disappeared in August 1986. SCP-9799 appeared on a single occasion within Helby House, a 19th-century country house in southern Lincolnshire, England, on 2007/11/06.

SCP-9800 is the provisional designation for an anomalous event that led to the transformation of a large area of land, entirely encompassing Site-618, into a contiguous rice paddy field. Attempts to re-establish communication with the Site have been unsuccessful. With the exception of a Dr. Felix Bowie, all Site-618 personnel have been considered MIA.
A temporary outpost has been established within the vicinity of Site-618 to support investigation efforts, which are presently ongoing.

SCP-9802 is an outdoor air-conditioning unit which is sentient and proficient in American English. How SCP-9802 vocalizes is currently unknown, and it does not display fluency in any language except its current dialect. Otherwise, SCP-9802 is completely non-anomalous.

SCP-9803 is a phenomenon that manifests as an internet advertisement. Instances have appeared across a wide range of websites, with little correlation between site content or viewer demographic, aside from affected websites hosting low quality "chumbox"-style clickbait advertisements.
SCP-9803 consists of a picture of an individual reported missing, accompanied by crudely formatted text such as "see where they are now", or "see what they've been up to." Minor variation has been observed across m

The handle is wrapped in blue tape to improve the grip, and can be held without triggering any discernible effects. Individuals in possession of SCP-9804 are referred to as the Batter.
In order for SCP-9804 to display anomalous properties, the following must be true:

SCP-9805 was an entity which briefly manifested during an unrelated scientific project. No other materializations of SCP-9805 have been recorded.

SCP-9807 is a beige, push-button telephone. While unbranded, it is both visibly and mechanically similar to telephones used in offices during the 80's.
SCP-9807’s other anomalous effects manifest when a call is made in a sales context. Upon a caller performing a “sales pitch” for any product belonging to a brand, the receiver, now designated SCP-9807-1, becomes a regular consumer of the brand’s products. SCP-9807-1 instances have also presented elevated consumerist tendencies, as well as loyalty

SCP-9808 constitutes the only known Multiversal Constant3 documented by the Multi-Foundation Coalition.

In all cases, this rot has resulted in the total collapse of the building and the deaths of all individuals inside. As every collapse has occurred during the middle of a Sunday service, each incident has resulted in considerable fatalities.

Only the Staff entrance appears to be inaccessible. Foundation personnel have yet to determine how to access this port; attempts to utilize other anomalies, including SCP-005, have been unsuccessful.1

Subjects who are affected by SCP-9818 initially exhibit an increased productive capacity, at the cost of neglecting their own physical and mental health. As the SCP-9818 event progresses, so does a subject's obsession with productivity, opting to spend their time off continuing to work. SCP-9820 is a viral phenomenon causing the organelles in the host's somatic cells1 to spontaneously exit the cell through anomalous means. This process is inevitably fatal. Upon infection, the speed of the effects will progress exponentially, with overall time taken varying from host to host. As of current research, four stages to the infection have been determined, each presenting with identifying symptoms:

SCP-9824, set in Egypt, is centered around a couple, Mara and Naomi, who must solve puzzles and avoid mythological beings3 in order to escape a pyramid while being stalked by an undead Pharaoh named Eiret.

SCP-9827 were 10 duplicates of a man named Garrett Matney. All drowned on the same day (December 31st, 2025) in different locations. SCP-9827 only came to Foundation attention after its neutralization, when its 10 sets of remains were all separately identified as the same individual. SCP-9828 refers to the Red Block at the former location of Site-422, a CI2M filtration camp for civilian and military prisoners.
SCP-9830 does not exist.

SCP-9832 is a neurochemical serum that inoculates the neocortex from cognitohazardous effects. Following a study of anomalous entities resistant to these effects, Foundation researchers extracted samples of cerebrospinal fluid from these entities and cross-tested them with a sample of one-hundred D-class, documenting their effects prior to, during, and following mild cognitohazardous exposure. SCP-9835 was a building located in North Wales, which operated from 2001 to 2016 under the name "The Manticore Hotel.". While in operation, SCP-9835 was a multiversal hub for anomalous activity, kept in check by GoI-119 "The Manticore Corporation". SCP-9835 appeared to only be 30m tall when observed from the outside but its true height was estimated at 3048m.
SCP-9835 currently lays in ruin, with very little of the structure remaining. Following 2016/05/23, all anomalous activity has ceased.

First brought to the attention of the Special Collections Program following an expulsion event occurring at the Providence Children's Hospital in El Paso, Texas in 1990. SCP-9838 begins, conditionally, from the rooftop of the Houston General Hospital, located in Houston, Texas. Any human subject who intentionally leaps from the roof of the building with the intent to end their own life will pass through it. SCP-9839 is a form of human blood that has unusual optical properties. It is an exceptionally bright shade of red — more so than any existing pigment or any electronic display can properly replicate. SCP-9839 will continue to appear red even in the absence of red light, or in concentrations where regular blood would appear black. Details of SCP-9839's appearance are abnormally easy to discern, even at a distance or under adverse conditions.

SCP-9840 exhibits limited psionic abilities that affect only individuals it has activ

SCP-9841 is an anti-memetic anomaly that causes increasing levels of apathy towards any given Foundation employee's career at the Foundation from their acquaintances, friends, and family members. SCP-9841 almost universally affects all acquaintances, family members, and relatives of all SCP Foundation personnel, and appears to intensify over a prolonged period of time, as long as the relevant Foundation personnel continues to be employed at the Foundation.
In a case of SCP-9841 affliction, the F
SCP-9842 was recovered from an overgrown tomb outside the Sicilian city of Syracuse.

SCP-9844 refers to a low-level, object-oriented, statically typed programming language known as ██████, originally written as a competitor to the Java programming language. SCP-9844 was created sometime between 1997 and 2003 at ████████████, a now defunct technology and software company based in Buffalo, New York. SCP-9848 is a pocket unwindable tape measure which kind of looks like a Stanley Powerlock 25-Foot Pocket Tape Measure. Pretty much all writing and numbering on SCP-9848 seems to be anomalously difficult to read. Attempts to capture the markings on SCP-9848 using different measurement equipment will yield differing results.1 SCP-9848 appears to gradually infect the environment around it with anomalous ontogeometric distortion unless information about it is actively obscured.2
SCP-9850 is a working pot-still distillery located in the Scottish Highlands.

Una vez cada 24 horas, SCP-9853 produce una masa firme, ovalada y blanca desde un agujero ubicado dentro de la "boca" del sujeto. Mientras que la capa más externa de estos objetos es químicamente comparable al ca

SCP-9856 is a two minute long song recorded on a cassette tape. The song is sung in an unknown language by a single female voice. In the background, songbirds, wind, and footsteps are audible. When SCP-9856 is played, strawberry plants1 rapidly grow from the source of the recording. As testing is still ongoing, the full capabilities of SCP-9856 are currently unknown.

Discovered in the inventory of the Jesus Christ of Our Sorrows Clinic, Chattanooga, TN 1980. Latex male contraceptives of the Anti-Baby brand produced by Celestino Group Inc. Their peculiarity lies in an outer layer of seminal fluid derived from an unknown mammalian species, with a shelf life of two months under ambient conditions. It is capable of fertilizing humans, resulting in a corniform mole. SCP-9860 is manufactured at a facility in Chattanooga, a subsidiary of Celestino Group Inc.
SCP-9862-alpha first uploaded to file sharing website jeemsreview.██1 and later to YouTube as far back as June 2 2010, commonly titled "Fish From Hell" or variations thereof.

SCP-9863 is a condition affecting approximately 1% of people possessing severe food allergies1. Individuals affected by SCP-9863 occasionally suffer anaphylactic shock reactions consistent with their consumption of an allergen when no such allergen is present in the consumed food2. While formerly integrated into the micro-culture of the region, public awareness of SCP-9866 has since faded into obscurity. It has accepted this status quo and expressed satisfaction with it.

Upon removal of SCP-9868 from the object's surface, the object ceases to be owned.

SCP-9869 is biology, a feature of the high-energy regime of the very early universe characterised by remarkable speed, adaptability, and the ability to allow complex structure and intelligence in the deeply hostile early expansion environment.

SCP-9870 is an environmental anomaly superficially similar to extreme cold. While the precise conditions needed for manifestation are not yet known, it can manifest anywhere on the surface of the Earth once the temperature falls below freezing. After a variable period of time, SCP-9870 manifestations dissipate spontaneously. No consistent conditions causing these dissipations have yet been identified. Affected environments frequently experience snowstorms and/or dense fog.

Recovered instances are individually enclosed in transparent polymer wrappers bearing a stylized yellow W. No manufacturer, ingredients, or other identifying information is present. Chemical analysis of recovered SCP-9872 material has identified conventional gum base, sweeteners, flavoring compounds, stabilizers, and food-grade additives. Though it has no effect on electromagnetic radiation entering our solar system, it absorbs all outwards emissions between the frequencies of 0.4-10.4 GHz, which constitute a large fraction of the Terrestrial Microwave Window1. The anomaly is primarily known to present among individuals hunting in pairs (with each individual given the designation, SCP-9906-1). Recovered by local authorities in Soddy-Daisy, Tennessee upon receiving a report of several youths smoking in public. All but one managed to escape before apprehension; during questioning, the youth stated that the group was smoking a folding table, rather than tobacco or any illicit substance. He then demonstrated SCP-9908's properties to justify his claim. The object was subsequently confiscated.

An enlarged human eye takes up a majority of SCP-9912’s face; no other facial features are present. A thin, glowing ring floats perpetually above SCP-9912’s head.

Wheaton following an undisclosed incident. Upon reaching the stage, instances of SCP-9917-1 perform involuntary choreiform movements. These movements do not correspond to the individual's known training or abilities. These transformations are entirely at random, and occur on a global scale.

In order to function, SCP-9921 requires 15L of gasoline deposited into a fuel tank on its back every 4 months. SCP-9934 refers to mayflies that emerge from the bodies of a portion of the human population after death.

SCP-9946 is a humanoid anomaly formerly known as Karina Mirales. SCP-9946 is 157cm tall and weighs 46 kg. SCP-9946 wears pink hospital scrubs that are unremovable. SCP-9946 does not require sleep, water, or food to function.

Direct visual exposure to an anomalous episode causes the viewer to become incorporated into the episode itself. The effect appears to be independent of age, with children, adults, and elderly subjects all demonstrating the same response.

It caused both auditory and visual hallucinations in the affected; subjects described a voice calling them to violence or revolt, and a female figure appearing at the edges of their vision. Ludus has no known origin. It appears to be attested on every inhabited continent and in every historical period for which usable records exist, with apparent fidelity across accounts.

SCP-9958 is an audio cassette, containing a 23 minute and 58 second long recording. The phrase "Oh, lost sheep blinded by false light, for you I shed my blood, for you I died" is written on the cassette with a white marker. SCP-9958 is a source of unique cognitohazards that are referred to as the "Words of Wisdom" by the entities related to the anomaly. Research into the specific nature of these cognitohazards is ongoing.

Observed hosts include: Heads of State, Corporate Executives, Military Officials, Celebrities, Religious Leaders and Financial Authorities.
SCP-9960 appears capable of inhabiting only one individual at a time. Habitation periods range between 3 and 5 months before spontaneous departure occur
SCP-9961 was a transformative event that affected Senior Researcher Charles Stafford (retroactively designated SCP-9961-1) during a New Year's Eve party at Site-76.

SCP-9965's mucus contains a strong paralyzing agent used to incapacitate prey. SCP-1622 is a specimen of Citrus × sinensis (sweet orange), originating from Lakeland, FL. It is a navel orange, with a small protrusion at one of its ends. SCP-1622 appears to continuously consume its own body through its non-navel apex, while the other end produces new matter. It will consume itself in small, irregular amounts, and not in a continuous motion.

data.descriptionExcerpt:
SCP-ES-303 es una sustancia químicamente semejante al plasma sanguíneo humano del tipo 0-. Este no muestra signos de putrefacción ni otro tipo de polución en ella, además de que diversas pruebas han mostrado que esta repele todo tipo de sustancia capaz de contaminar la sangre. Además, SCP-ES-303 ha demostrado ser incapaz de coagularse.
Los análisis indican que SCP-ES-303 contiene el código genético de al menos 6 personas, de las cuales ninguna ha logrado ser identificada.

SCP-ES-336 era una inteligencia artificial avanzada que residía dentro de un teléfono móvil Samsung Galaxy Ace 2, la cual funcionaba como el sistema operativo del dispositivo. La única función hallada en el teléfono era una aplicación de mensajería por la cual era posible establecer comunicación con él. SCP-ES-336 servía como un chatbot que realizaba actividades de roleplay1 con el usuario. Se desconoce cómo el hardware era capaz de sostener las respuestas generadas por SCP-ES-336.

data.descriptionExcerpt: Fenómeno metamórfico afectando potencialmente todos los textos archivados en la Bóveda de Registros del Sitio-34.
